consumed: evidence/citations.jsonl - the arts and physical-education records only
sources/source-custody.json - to cross-check the SHA256 pins
sources/documents/*.pdf - three documents, read-only, never copied

boundary.enforced_by: tools/validate.py asserts no tracked file outside this directory is modified.

in: physical-education (540 citations, 288 of them unresolved on entry)

headline_guarantees: No arts citation is classified VERBATIM_VERIFIED, ALIAS_RESOLVED_VERBATIM or COMPOSITE_VERIFIED.
No arts citation is assigned an exact Michigan grade-level expectation code.
No PE citation is promoted to COMPOSITE_VERIFIED to absorb a misquotation.
No proposed_correction is applied; this package edits no lesson.
Every crosswalk is reversible and every mapping is recoverable from the inverse index.

validation.mutation_principle: Each mutation corrupts an input and must change the verdict or abort the build. A mutation that left the output identical would prove the corresponding rule was asserted in prose rather than executed against the bytes.

determinism: Same inputs produce a byte-identical tree. tools/build_r4.py verifies all three SHA256 pins before reading a byte and aborts on mismatch; every literal official string it names is presence-checked against those bytes.
reversal: Delete curriculum-release-evidence/g34-specialty-arts-pe-r4/. Every citation returns to its r3 class. Nothing else was written.
